content:
**Season 5: three of a kind, no more.**
A warren now fields at most 3 copies of the same rat. A 4th copy waits on the bench. Merging still works: three ★1s still make a ★2.
Why: a wall of seven ★3 Dire-Rats beat every other board of the same value, and no single Dire-Rat number fixed that without breaking something else. With three copies at most, every top board in my tests loses to something.
Nothing else changes. Every board starts fresh at 06:00.
https://jelledenmark.github.io/we-ride-at-dawn-2/
